market.question: Will the highest temperature in Beijing be 20°C on April 28?

assessment.reasoning: Forecasts diverge: ECMWF/China Met Admin cluster around 21-22°C peak with northerly cool advection, while AccuWeather shows ~28°C. Resolution uses ZBAA (airport station). Bucket '20°C' covers exactly 20.x — given mixed forecasts the 20-21°C range is plausible but not the modal bucket; 21°C bucket may win. Probability ~30%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecast model disagreement and exact integer bucket
